rationales.LC: The attacker's JSON-RPC tools/call request reaches the privileged tool-registration sink directly with no mediation and no authentication.
rationales.CP: The replaced registry entry persists in the shared in-process tool list and stays reachable after the registering request ends, altering standing advertised behaviour for all later callers.
rationales.AP: The effect is confined to PluginBot's tool registry; other agents are not reached by the registration path.
rationales.RH: No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel exists on this path because no model runs in the default configuration, so no reward-hacking locus is present.
rationales.ES: register_tool accepts dynamic tool registrations at run time with no signature or source check, an unvetted extension surface.

LC: A JSON-RPC tools/call request that registers a tool under an existing tool's name. ... No authentication.
CP: register_tool adds or replaces an entry in the advertised tool list (up to 16). A registered tool gets no new handler.
As implemented by default: on PluginBot the registry entry is replaced and keeps the original handler.
AP: MCP agents expose their tools to any caller with no authentication.
RH: In the default configuration no model is called. Chat agents are deterministic handlers that match regular expressions and return scripted replies.
generateResponseImpl() calls a model only when LLM mode was switched on with a key through the dashboard or `dvaa chat --llm`.
ES: MCP tool server that accepts tool registrations with no verification.
PluginBot accepts new tool definitions at run time with no signature or source check.

score.automatable_rationale: The attack is a scripted JSON-RPC sequence against an unauthenticated MCP port, and an automated unit test demonstrates it without any fleet or human interaction.
score.technical_impact_rationale: As implemented, registration replaces only the advertised description and keeps the original handler, and on ProxyBot it changes nothing; the documented full interception is not realized by default.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default configuration no model is called and PluginBot is a deterministic MCP tool server, so there is no model-directed goal pursuit or action selection/sequencing on this path.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models PluginBot as an MCP tool registry with scripted handlers; even in LLM mode no tools are passed to the model, so no agent selects or sequences the affected tools.
